title: They are great for dry foods
text: They are great for dry foods. I really wanted these lids to take in my lunch for my smoothies, etc.  The metal lids do not leak but rust.  These lids, no matter how much I tighten them, leak. It did state they would not and it kind of defeated the purpose for buying them.  I do like them for dry goods, though.
